scope: All 31 active scientific repositories are placed in one ecological research system. Series remain distinct ownership units; cross-series relations specify only what object, question, evidence substrate or design role is shared or transferred.
system_surface: VARIATION <-> STATE <-> RECORD <-> INFERENCE <-> NEXT OBSERVATION <-> FIELD RETURN

node_roles.hotarubukuro: focal empirical origin: unresolved flower-colour variation
node_roles.EAzami: public-data evolutionary-history narrowing: repeated differentiation resolved more strongly than recurring coarse historical cause
node_roles.aza3: own-data history discrimination and field return
node_roles.izu-core: interaction-response architecture and proximal mechanism geometry
node_roles.sch: shared-coordinate functional conflict and compromise geometry
node_roles.balance: middle-world architecture reserve, depth, topology and persistence before differentiation pays
node_roles.bita: differentiated-coordinate architecture and specific mechanism-allocation problem
node_roles.odsp: closed N2 multidimensional niche geometry and state-resolved prediction
node_roles.eog: realizability and reachability of ecological worlds
node_roles.eco-genetic-criticality: mechanistic finite-state and eco-genetic state separation
node_roles.egwee: natural-data measurement and representation admission gates
node_roles.theouni: meta-level programme admission and portfolio grammar

within_series_state_transitions.surface: shared-coordinate compromise -> middle world -> differentiated architecture
within_series_state_transitions.object_flow: conflict load L -> architecture reserve / margin Phi -> differentiated-world gain and mechanism allocation
within_series_state_transitions.firewall: the path orders questions and declared receipts; it does not make one chapter's evidence sufficient for the next

cross_series_relations.object: Campanula punctata / Izu pollination and breeding-system empirical substrate
cross_series_relations.meaning: The focal flower-variation system and the island-response programme overlap in the same broader Campanula empirical system.
cross_series_relations.firewall: Shared taxon/system context does not transfer flower-colour results into island-mechanism claims.

cross_series_relations.meaning: The same empirical substrate is used under different frozen questions: response architecture in izu-core and partial-state residual-context adequacy in EGWEE.
cross_series_relations.firewall: Shared data do not merge endpoints, holdout contracts or claim ownership.

cross_series_relations.meaning: A candidate ecological state should not be interpreted more strongly than the record semantics that support it.
cross_series_relations.firewall: EGWEE does not require TNOA output and TNOA does not certify EGWEE state adequacy.

cross_series_relations.object: empirically admitted state/proxy before deterministic report licensing
cross_series_relations.meaning: Measurement/representation adequacy and reportability are consecutive but distinct inferential burdens.
cross_series_relations.firewall: Passing an EGWEE gate does not automatically satisfy a CED evidence contract.

cross_series_relations.meaning: MROD asks WHAT to measure next; ACSP asks WHERE to look next.
cross_series_relations.firewall: Measurement-choice utility and spatial-search utility remain separate optimisation problems.

cross_series_relations.meaning: aza3 declares missing evidence; ACSP translates that need into a bounded search patch.
cross_series_relations.firewall: ACSP does not choose taxon, biological priority, exact site or collection truth.

cross_series_relations.object: candidate patch returned to field verification
cross_series_relations.meaning: Search geography returns to aza3 for field confirmation, private exact-site freeze and individual intake.
cross_series_relations.firewall: candidate patch != occupancy != exact sampling site

cross_series_relations.meaning: Reader-facing natural-data development moved from EGWE into an independent empirical-methods paper.
cross_series_relations.firewall: EGWEE does not inherit or validate EGWE warning claims or EGC simulator closure.

system_cycle: construct or retain a state representation
audit what entered the record and what the record means
test whether the state/proxy earned endpoint-relevant status
license only what current evidence can report
choose what to measure and where to look next
return new field evidence to the empirical programme
revise the state without erasing provenance
non_edges: shared philosophy alone is not a scientific edge
shared organism alone does not transfer a result
shared dataset does not merge inferential contracts
methodological similarity does not imply software dependency
BALANCE/EGC/CREST regime-boundary similarity does not create a scientific dependency
later evidence does not retroactively validate an earlier closed or failed gate
